title: Review YourTal
intro: Everything here is a demo: the businesses, videos, points and money are made up, and nothing leaves this server. Sign in as any of the people below and try the journeys.

logins.heading: Demo logins
logins.intro: One login per person, in each region. Australia is in English and AUD; Indonesia in Bahasa and IDR. The two never mix.
logins.passwordAsk: The password for these logins comes from the founder.

viewer.try: Starts at the beginning: points pending, first streak.

adult.try: Has points and vouchers: gift one, list one for charity, bid.

teen.try: Teen feed only, no streaks, no gifts or auctions, a daily cap.

guardian.try: Approves the teen; the consent email is in the inbox below.

owner.try: Studio: campaigns, boost, inventory, billing, team and the counter.

member.try: Studio with a marketer's rights: campaigns, not billing.

logins.counter: Store counter: sign in as the business owner, open Studio › Team, add a device and copy its pairing code. Open {pairUrl} on another device, enter the code, then the PIN {pin}.
logins.staffNote: Staff console logins are not listed here; the founder has them.

items.home: Home: long videos in a grid. Pick a category, open Filters, choose topics and a sort, then reload: the filters stay.
items.shorts: Shorts: swipe; Shorts earn in place, with no questions.
items.watch: Watch and earn: a long video asks questions part-way; points arrive pending, then unlock.
items.store: Store: search, filter by where to use it, points range and brand, then redeem a voucher.
items.wallet: Wallet: balance, what's on its way, active vouchers, and the history by day.
items.gift: Gift a voucher: open an unused voucher in the Wallet and choose Gift; the other viewer accepts it in their Wallet.
items.auction: Charity auction: list a voucher for a charity from its page, then bid on it as the other viewer.
items.boost: Boost: as the business owner, open a live campaign in Studio and set a daily boost budget.
items.theme: Light and dark: the avatar menu at the top right, or Me.
items.open: Watch without an account: a public video page plays, but nothing is earned.

tools.heading: Tools
tools.clock: Clock: move time forward to unlock pending points, end auctions or expire vouchers.
tools.inbox: Inbox: every email and text the app would have sent (verification, guardian consent, receipts).

simulated.heading: What is simulated
items: Card payments and charity payouts (no real money moves)
Email and SMS (they land in the inbox above)
